source: Self-generated legacy pin, not an oracle (D-68, D-239). Format v2 blobs written by dstu-core 0.6.0's crypto_box::seal / crypto_box512::seal at commit 8dd830f, before T-265 replaced the written format with v3; the one-off generator was removed with it, since the code can no longer produce v2. Since 0.8.0 (T-310) nothing reads these: every open refuses them as unsupported_version. Plaintext: (i*31+7) mod 256.

uacrypt_0_6_0.source: Real uacrypt 0.6.0 release binary (v0.6.0 GitHub Release, uacrypt-windows-x86_64.zip, SHA256 3c1c895b...e16e9e): box-keygen/box-keygen512, box-pubkey, box-seal of a 20000-byte (i*31+7) mod 256 plaintext.
